- Accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded and aria-controls, named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected, in role="group"s named by their labels. Typing filters and opens the list; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight while focus stays in the input (aria-activedescendant), Enter chooses, Escape closes and then clears, and Tab leaves. The chevron button is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology, as the input already opens the list; the clear button is reachable by pointer and is named by clearLabel. The status line is aria-live="polite", so loading and errors of an async search are announced without moving focus; the no-results line is announced the same way. The chosen item shows a check mark, so the state does not rest on colour; the frame's bottom edge is color.border.control-bottom (3:1 on every fill and surface). The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.

### CommandPalette

[command-palette.json](command-palette.json): The searchable list of every action, on Base UI's Dialog and an inline Autocomplete: a search field over grouped commands with icons and shortcuts, filtered in the page by label and keywords, opened by a hotkey; no network.

Usage: Use CommandPalette as the one place where every action of the app can be found and run from the keyboard, with its shortcut shown: DBee's Ctrl+K / Ctrl+Shift+P. Pass groups of commands ({ id, label, shortcut, keywords, icon, disabled, onSelect }), control open with open and onOpenChange (and a button with aria-haspopup="dialog" for pointer users), and give hotkeys ("Mod+K": Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere) to toggle it anywhere. The palette closes before onSelect runs, so a command may open a dialog. Keep the list in sync with the app's shortcuts; for a few actions behind a button use DropdownMenu; for picking a value in a form, Combobox.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/autocomplete
- Parts: CommandPaletteItem (data-slot command-palette-item): One command's row, role="option": icon, label and shortcut (<kbd>), DropdownMenu's item look; CommandPalette renders one per command.
- Props: groups ({ label: string; items: Command[] }[]); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean) => void); hotkeys (string[]); placeholder (string, default "Type a command"); emptyText (ReactNode, default "No matching commands"); title (string, default "Command palette"); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.scrim, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.dialog.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.gentle, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, radius.lg, radius.md, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.panel.lg, size.panel.sm, space.inline.lg, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.md, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.modal, z.overlay
- Accessibility: The palette is a modal role="dialog" named by a visually hidden title; focus goes to the search field (role="combobox") which controls a role="listbox" of role="option" commands in role="group"s named by their headings. Typing filters by label, keywords and group and highlights the first match; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight (aria-activedescendant) while focus stays in the field; Enter runs the highlighted command; Escape closes and focus returns to where it was. The hotkeys toggle the palette from anywhere; every command shows its own shortcut, so the palette also teaches them. Disabled commands are shown, so the user learns they exist, but cannot run. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns Dialog's transitions off. The palette takes the theme and density of the region where it is placed.

### ContextMenu

[context-menu.json](context-menu.json): A menu opened by a right-click or the context-menu key on an area, on Base UI's ContextMenu: DropdownMenu's items (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus) at the pointer, on elevation.flyout (color.bg.overlay) at z.popover.

Usage: Use ContextMenu for the actions of the thing under the pointer: a tree node, a grid cell, a tab. Compose it as ContextMenu > ContextMenuTrigger (the area; give it its own classes) + ContextMenuContent > ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuRadioGroup with ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuGroup with ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, and ContextMenuSub > ContextMenuSubTrigger + ContextMenuSubContent. A right-click is not discoverable and not available to everyone: every action in it must also be reachable another way (a toolbar, a DropdownMenu, the CommandPalette, a shortcut). For a menu behind a visible button use DropdownMenu.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/context-menu
- Parts: ContextMenuTrigger (data-slot context-menu-trigger): The area that opens the menu on right-click or the context-menu key; a <div>, unstyled.; ContextMenuContent (data-slot context-menu-content): The portal, the positioner at the pointer and the menu.; ContextMenuItem (data-slot context-menu-item): role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.; ContextMenuCheckboxItem (data-slot context-menu-checkbox-item): role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.; ContextMenuRadioGroup (data-slot context-menu-radio-group): role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.; ContextMenuRadioItem (data-slot context-menu-radio-item): role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.; ContextMenuGroup (data-slot context-menu-group): role="group", named by its ContextMenuLabel.; ContextMenuLabel (data-slot context-menu-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ContextMenuSeparator (data-slot context-menu-separator): role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.; ContextMenuShortcut (data-slot context-menu-shortcut): The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ContextMenuSubTrigger (data-slot context-menu-sub-trigger): An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.; ContextMenuSubContent (data-slot context-menu-sub-content): The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean, default true); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.overlay, color.border.strong, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, radius.lg, radius.md, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.lg, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.md, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The popup is role="menu" of role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" and "menuitemradio" items with aria-checked; groups are role="group" named by their label. A right-click opens the menu at the pointer; on a focused area the context-menu key or Shift+F10 opens it (the browser sends the same contextmenu event). Focus moves into the menu; arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and returns focus. ArrowRight on a sub-trigger opens its submenu, ArrowLeft closes it. Disabled items stay reachable but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. Every action in a context menu is also available elsewhere (toolbar, DropdownMenu, CommandPalette, shortcut), because right-click is not discoverable. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the slide and fade transitions off. The menu takes the area's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

### DatePicker

[date-picker.json](date-picker.json): A date or a range of dates, typed into a text field (read with date-fns in a format, yyyy-MM-dd by default) or picked from a Calendar in a popup, on InputGroup and Base UI's Popover, in three sizes.

Usage: Use DatePicker for a day in a form or a filter (a restore point, a snapshot date), and mode="range" for a window of days (query history, an audit period). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel: the text field takes the label, description and validity. The value is a local Date at midnight (range: { from, to }, both ends), or null when empty or when the text is not a date in format; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field, and validate null as missing. Limit the days with min, max and disabledDays (react-day-picker matchers, such as { dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }). Pass a date-fns locale for the calendar's language and first weekday; keep format unambiguous (yyyy-MM-dd, or dd/MM/yyyy where the locale reads it). For a time of day use TimePicker beside it; for a calendar that stays visible, Calendar. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/popover
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: mode ("single" | "range", default "single"); value (Date | { from: Date; to: Date } | null); defaultValue (Date | { from: Date; to: Date } | null); onValueChange ((value) => void); format (string, default "yyyy-MM-dd"); locale (Locale (date-fns)); min (Date); max (Date); disabledDays (Matcher | Matcher[]); weekStartsOn (0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6); numberOfMonths (number, default "1 (2 for a range)"); appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); placeholder (string); calendarLabel (string, default "Choose date"); open (boolean); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), invalid (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][aria-invalid=true]]), selected (data-selected), disabled (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.compound, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.xl, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xl, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The text field is named by its FieldLabel (or aria-label), described by FieldDescription and FieldError, and aria-invalid while its text is not a date; the placeholder shows the format to type. The calendar button is named by calendarLabel ("Choose date") and has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; Alt+ArrowDown in the text field opens the calendar too. When the popup opens, focus moves to the chosen day (else today); the arrow keys, PageUp and PageDown move it, Enter or Space picks it, and the popup closes and returns focus to the text field. Escape closes it without a change. The calendar is a role="grid" per month with full-date labels on the days; days outside min, max or disabledDays are disabled and struck through. Everything the popup does can be done by typing the date, so the field also works without a pointer or the popup.

### DescriptionList

[description-list.json](description-list.json): Term/value pairs in a <dl>: the term beside its value or above it, optionally divided by rules; long values wrap.

Usage: Use DescriptionList for the facts of one thing: the grant summary in the approval dialog, a connection's details, About and diagnostics. Compose DescriptionList > DescriptionListItem > DescriptionListTerm + DescriptionListDetails (one or more). layout="stacked" in narrow panels; divided adds rules between items. For many records with the same fields use Table; for a single number use Stat.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Parts: DescriptionListItem (data-slot description-list-item): Groups one term with its values.; DescriptionListTerm (data-slot description-list-term): The term, a <dt>.; DescriptionListDetails (data-slot description-list-details): The value, a <dd>.
- layout: inline, stacked, aligned
- Props: layout ("inline" | "stacked" | "aligned", default "inline"); divided (boolean, default false); children (ReactNode); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDListElement>)
- States: divided (data-divided)
- Tokens: color.border.muted, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, font.mono, font.sans, size.panel.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.md, space.inline.xl, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight
- Accessibility: A real <dl> with <dt> and <dd> (each pair in a <div>, which HTML allows), so screen readers announce the list and pair terms with values. Terms are color.fg.muted and values color.fg.default, both contrast-checked as text. Long values (digests, paths) wrap instead of overflowing; not focusable.

### Dialog

[dialog.json](dialog.json): A modal dialog on Base UI's Dialog: a trigger, a scrim, a centred popup in four widths with a title, a description, a scrolling body, a footer of actions and a close button.

Usage: Use Dialog for a short task the user must finish or cancel before going on, on top of the page: export settings, rename, keyboard shortcuts, About. Compose it as Dialog > DialogTrigger (render a Button) + DialogContent > DialogHeader (DialogTitle, DialogDescription), DialogBody, DialogFooter (DialogClose rendering a Button, then the primary action last). Every dialog needs a DialogTitle; open it without a trigger through open and onOpenChange (from a menu item or a shortcut). For a decision that must not be dismissed by a click outside (delete, destructive SQL, approve access) use AlertDialog; for a form that edits something beside the page (a connection) use Sheet; for a small, non-modal panel attached to a control use Popover.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/dialog
- Parts: DialogTrigger (data-slot dialog-trigger): Opens the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render. aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.; DialogContent (data-slot dialog-content): The portal with the scrim, the viewport and the popup, plus a close IconButton unless showClose is false.; DialogBackdrop (data-slot dialog-backdrop): The scrim; DialogContent renders it.; DialogViewport (data-slot dialog-viewport): The centring layer; DialogContent renders it.; DialogHeader (data-slot dialog-header): The title and description, stacked, leaving room for the close button.; DialogTitle (data-slot dialog-title): An <h2> in text.subtitle-1 (Fluent's dialog title) that names the dialog (aria-labelledby).; DialogDescription (data-slot dialog-description): A <p> in color.fg.muted that describes the dialog (aria-describedby).; DialogBody (data-slot dialog-body): The content between header and footer; scrolls when the dialog is taller than the viewport.; DialogFooter (data-slot dialog-footer): The actions at the end of the row, the primary action last.; DialogClose (data-slot dialog-close): Closes the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render.
- size: sm, md, lg, xl
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", default "md"); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean | "trap-focus", default true); disablePointerDismissal (boolean, default false); showClose (boolean, default true); closeLabel (string, default "Close"); initialFocus (RefObject<HTMLElement> | boolean); finalFocus (RefObject<HTMLElement> | boolean); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.disabled, color.bg.layer, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.scrim, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, elevation.dialog.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.gentle, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.icon.lg, size.panel.lg, size.panel.md, size.panel.sm, size.panel.xl, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.stack.md, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.subtitle-1.leading, text.subtitle-1.size, text.subtitle-1.tracking, text.subtitle-1.weight, z.modal, z.overlay
- Accessibility: The popup is role="dialog", named by DialogTitle (aria-labelledby) and described by DialogDescription (aria-describedby); every dialog has a title. While it is open the rest of the page is hidden from assistive technology and inert (Base UI marks it, rather than setting aria-modal). Opening moves focus into the popup (the first focusable element, or initialFocus); Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside; closing returns focus to the trigger (or finalFocus). Escape closes the dialog, and so does a press on the scrim unless disablePointerDismissal is set; the page behind does not scroll and ignores the pointer while it is open. The close button is an IconButton with an accessible name (closeLabel, "Close" by default) and a visible focus ring. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off (motion-reduce:transition-none). The popup takes the theme and density of the region it is declared in, not only of <html>, so its contrast matches the page that opened it.

### DropdownMenu

[dropdown-menu.json](dropdown-menu.json): A menu of actions opened from a button, on Base UI's Menu: items with shortcuts and a danger tone, checkbox and radio items, groups with labels, separators and submenus, on elevation.flyout (color.bg.overlay) at z.popover.

Usage: Use DropdownMenu for a list of actions or options behind one button: tab actions under a "more" IconButton, copy formats, view options. Compose it as DropdownMenu > DropdownMenuTrigger (render a Button or IconButton) + DropdownMenuContent > DropdownMenuItem (onClick; danger for a destructive one; DropdownMenuShortcut at the end), DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (checked, onCheckedChange), DropdownMenuRadioGroup (value, onValueChange) with DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuGroup with DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, and DropdownMenuSub > DropdownMenuSubTrigger + DropdownMenuSubContent for a submenu. For a menu on right-click use ContextMenu; for an app's menu row, Menubar; for a primary action with variants, SplitButton; for picking a form value, Select; for a searchable list of every command, CommandPalette.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/menu
- Parts: DropdownMenuTrigger (data-slot dropdown-menu-trigger): Opens the menu; unstyled, render a Button or IconButton. aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded.; DropdownMenuContent (data-slot dropdown-menu-content): The portal, the positioner and the menu.; DropdownMenuItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-item): role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.; DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-checkbox-item): role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.; DropdownMenuRadioGroup (data-slot dropdown-menu-radio-group): role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.; DropdownMenuRadioItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-radio-item): role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.; DropdownMenuGroup (data-slot dropdown-menu-group): role="group", named by its DropdownMenuLabel.; DropdownMenuLabel (data-slot dropdown-menu-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; DropdownMenuSeparator (data-slot dropdown-menu-separator): role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.; DropdownMenuShortcut (data-slot dropdown-menu-shortcut): The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; DropdownMenuSubTrigger (data-slot dropdown-menu-sub-trigger): An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.; DropdownMenuSubContent (data-slot dropdown-menu-sub-content): The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean, default true); side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" | "inline-start" | "inline-end", default "bottom"); align ("start" | "center" | "end", default "start"); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.disabled, color.bg.layer, color.bg.overlay, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.lg, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The trigger has aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; the popup is role="menu" of role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" (aria-checked) and "menuitemradio" items; groups are role="group" named by their label. Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger opens the menu with the first item highlighted (ArrowUp: the last); arrow keys, Home and End move, typing jumps to an item, Enter or Space chooses, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. ArrowRight (inline-end) on a sub-trigger opens its submenu, ArrowLeft closes it. Disabled items stay reachable by the keyboard, as the ARIA menu pattern recommends, but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. A press outside closes the menu. A destructive item has danger and a clear label, so the meaning does not rest on colour; checked state shows a check mark or dot as well as aria-checked. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the slide and fade transitions off. The menu and its submenus take the trigger's theme and density, and sit at z.popover so a menu opened from a dialog is above it.

### EmptyState

[empty-state.json](empty-state.json): What a view shows when it has nothing to show yet: an icon, a title, a sentence and the way forward; centered for a panel, inline for small places.

Usage: Use EmptyState wherever a list, tree, grid or panel can be empty: first run ("No connections yet" with Add connection), a query with no rows, a filter with no matches. Say what is missing and what to do; offer one primary action. Compose EmptyState > EmptyStateIcon, EmptyStateTitle, EmptyStateDescription, EmptyStateActions; all optional. variant="inline" for a tree or a narrow list. For an error use Alert; for loading use Skeleton or Spinner.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Parts: EmptyStateIcon (data-slot empty-state-icon): A decorative icon in a soft circle.; EmptyStateTitle (data-slot empty-state-title): What is missing, an <h3> by default.; EmptyStateDescription (data-slot empty-state-description): Why it is empty and what to do.; EmptyStateActions (data-slot empty-state-actions): The way forward: one primary Button, maybe a secondary one.
- variant: centered, inline
- Props: variant ("centered" | "inline", default "centered"); children (ReactNode); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, font.sans, radius.lg, radius.md, size.control.lg, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.sm, size.panel.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xl, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.subtitle-2.leading, text.subtitle-2.size, text.subtitle-2.tracking, text.subtitle-2.weight
- Accessibility: The title is a heading (<h3>) so screen-reader users find the empty view; render a <p> inside small places (a tree) where a heading would be noise. The icon is aria-hidden; the title and description carry the meaning. Actions are ordinary buttons in reading order; put the primary action first. Long titles and descriptions wrap.

### Field

[field.json](field.json): A form field on Base UI's Field parts: label, control, description and error tied together, with invalid, touched, dirty and disabled state taken from TanStack Form or set by hand.

Usage: Wrap every form control (Input, Textarea, InputGroup) in a Field with a FieldLabel; add FieldDescription for a hint and FieldError for the message. A Checkbox or Switch goes inside its FieldLabel, next to the text. A group of options (RadioGroup, CheckboxGroup) is one Field: a FieldLegend first inside the group, then a FieldItem per option with its FieldLabel and, if needed, its own FieldDescription. Group related Fields under a heading with FieldSet and FieldLegend. With TanStack Form, render it from form.Field and pass the field: <form.Field name="host">{(field) => <Field field={field}>…</Field>}</form.Field>, and wire the control's value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field. Without a form library, set invalid and FieldError's children yourself, or use Base UI's validate prop. Put the fields in a Form.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/field
- Parts: FieldLabel (data-slot field-label): The visible label, tied to the control; an inline row with gap space.inline.sm, so it can wrap a Checkbox, Radio or Switch and its text; danger-coloured while invalid, dimmed while disabled.; FieldDescription (data-slot field-description): A hint under the control, in color.fg.muted, named by aria-describedby.; FieldError (data-slot field-error): The validation message in color.status.danger.fg: its children, its errors prop, or the TanStack field's errors one per line.; FieldItem (data-slot field-item): One option of a RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup: its FieldLabel and FieldDescription in a column with gap space.stack.xs; disabled disables that option.; FieldSet (data-slot field-set): A <fieldset> grouping related Fields under a FieldLegend, a column with gap space.stack.md; disabled disables every control inside.; FieldLegend (data-slot field-legend): The name of a FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup, placed first inside it, in text.label; the group's aria-labelledby points to it.
- Props: field (FieldState (a TanStack Form field: name and state.meta)); name (string); invalid (boolean); touched (boolean); dirty (boolean); disabled (boolean, default false); validate ((value, formValues) => string | string[] | null | Promise<…>); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.status.danger.fg, font.sans, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.stack.md, space.stack.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: FieldLabel is a <label> tied to the control, so clicking it focuses the control and screen readers announce it as the control's name. FieldDescription and FieldError are named in the control's aria-describedby; the error is read when the control is focused. A FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup is named by its FieldLegend through aria-labelledby; a FieldDescription inside a FieldItem describes that option only. An invalid field sets aria-invalid on the control; FieldError shows Fluent's ErrorCircle (aria-hidden) before the message, and the message, not the danger colour, carries the meaning. Show errors after the user leaves the field or submits (the default with a TanStack field: touched and invalid), not on the first keystroke. color.status.danger.fg and color.fg.muted are contrast-checked as text on every surface.

### FileInput

[file-input.json](file-input.json): A file picker on a native <input type="file"> (Base UI's Input), as one line like an Input or as a dashed dropzone, with a Clear button and accept filtering of dropped files.

Usage: Use FileInput to pick local files the app reads in the browser or sends with the form: a CA certificate, a key, SQL scripts to import. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; set accept (".pem,.crt", "image/*") and multiple as on the native input. Read the files from onFilesChange ([] when cleared); with TanStack Form, keep File[] in the field and call field.handleChange from onFilesChange. The dropzone variant also takes dropped files (filtered by accept) and suits imports; the field variant suits settings forms. Nothing is uploaded by the component; it has no network code. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- variant: field, dropzone
- Props: onFilesChange ((files: File[]) => void); accept (string); multiple (boolean, default false); variant ("field" | "dropzone", default "field"); appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); chooseLabel (string, default "Choose file"); emptyLabel (string, default "No file chosen"); dropLabel (string, default "Drop a file here, or"); clearLabel (string, default "Clear file"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input]:focus-visible]), dragging (data-dragging), empty (data-empty), invalid (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.compound, color.accent.subtle-bg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: The control is a native <input type="file">, visually hidden but focusable: Tab reaches it, Space or Enter opens the system picker, and screen readers announce its label and the chosen file. The chip and the file names repeat what the input announces, so they are aria-hidden; the FieldLabel names the input and clicking it opens the picker. Dropping files is a pointer shortcut only; the same files can always be chosen with the keyboard. Announce what was added in a role="status" element. The Clear button is named "Clear file" and returns focus to the input. Focus shows Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline) along the frame's bottom, 3:1 on every fill and surface.

### Form

[form.json](form.json): A <form> laid out as a column of Fields and submitted through TanStack Form: no native validation, handleSubmit on submit, focus on the first invalid field.

Usage: Create the form with useForm from @tanstack/react-form (defaultValues, validators, onSubmit), pass it as form, and render each field with form.Field and a Field inside. For a native-like flow use validationLogic: revalidateLogic({ mode: "submit", modeAfterSubmission: "change" }); for per-field checks use validators.onBlur. Show the submit state with form.Subscribe and Button's loading. Without form, Form is only a styled <form>.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Props: form (AnyFormApi (from useForm)); noValidate (boolean); onSubmit ((event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => void); aria-label (string); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLFormElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: space.stack.md
- Accessibility: Renders a native <form>, so Enter in a text field submits it; keep a type="submit" Button in it. After a failed submit, focus moves to the first invalid control in document order, and its FieldError is read through aria-describedby. Name the form with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has more than one. Errors appear on submit and then follow each change (revalidateLogic) or on blur, never on the first keystroke of an untouched field. Announce the outcome of a submission in a role="status" region; the submit Button's loading sets aria-busy.

### GraphView

[graph-view.json](graph-view.json): A read-only directed graph laid out in layers (dagre), with pan, zoom, groups, running and visited nodes, and keyboard navigation along its edges.

Usage: Use GraphView to show how steps connect: a LangGraph assistant's nodes and edges (Mightyconsole), a workflow, a pipeline. Pass nodes and edges; kind start and end draw small pills, conditional edges are dashed, and nodes with a group are drawn inside that group's box (a subgraph seen with xray). While something runs, pass activeIds (accent fill) and visitedIds (accent edge): the edges between them light up too. selectedId and onNodeSelect make nodes selectable (click or Enter); onNodeOpen takes a double-click. A node with a detail draws two lines (a workflow ID, then its status dot, status and type), emphasis marks the node the graph is about, and dashed edges show messages between nodes (signals) rather than steps. Give it a height (h-panel-md, h-full in a sized panel); it fits the graph on first draw and when the graph or its size changes. The layout is computed, not measured, so labels longer than about 28 characters are cut with an ellipsis (the full label is the node's tooltip and name). For a hierarchy use Tree; for a timeline of steps, Timeline; to edit a graph, nothing here: it is read-only.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: nodes ({ id: string; label: string; kind?: "start" | "end" | "node" | "subgraph"; group?: string; detail?: string; tone?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger"; emphasis?: boolean }[]); edges ({ source: string; target: string; conditional?: boolean; dashed?: boolean; label?: string }[]); groups ({ id: string; label: string }[], default "[]"); direction ("TB" | "LR", default "\"TB\""); activeIds (string[], default "[]"); visitedIds (string[], default "[]"); selectedId (string | null, default "null"); onNodeSelect ((id: string) => void); onNodeOpen ((id: string) => void); aria-label (string, default "\"Graph\""); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: active (data-active), visited (data-visited), selected (data-selected), panning (data-panning), hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), detail (data-detail)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.compound, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-bg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.disabled, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.default, color.border.disabled, color.border.strong, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.interactive.selected-hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.info.solid, elevation.layer.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.md, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: The root is a named group (aria-roledescription "graph"); the nodes are buttons with one tab stop between them (roving tabindex), in layout order. Arrow keys along the direction follow the edges (Down or Right to the next node, Up or Left back); the other two move across the same layer; Home and End go to the first and last node; Enter or Space selects; + and - zoom, 0 fits. A node's name says its state (", running", ", done"); the edges are a visually hidden list ("plan to tools (conditional)"), so the shape is readable without the drawing. Conditional edges differ by their dash, not only by colour; running nodes by their fill and their name. Focus shows the double ring: ring.width in color.ring around ring.inner-width in color.ring-inner (3:1 on every surface).

### HexView

[hex-view.json](hex-view.json): Bytes as a hex dump: an offset column, the bytes in hex and as ASCII, virtualized, with keyboard selection and copy as hex or as text.

Usage: Use HexView to show binary payloads exactly: a message's raw key or value, a file's first bytes, a protocol frame. Set the height with className (it scrolls inside). Arrows move the active byte, Shift extends the selection, Ctrl+A selects everything, Ctrl+C copies the selection as hex and Ctrl+Shift+C as text (UTF-8 when it decodes, else Latin-1 with dots); the footer's buttons do the same, and onCopy reports the text. baseOffset numbers a slice of a larger payload. For decoded values use JsonViewer or CodeBlock; for one short value inline, Code.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: bytes (Uint8Array | number[], default "empty"); bytesPerRow (number, default 16); baseOffset (number, default 0); onCopy ((text: string, format: "hex" | "text") => void); aria-label (string, default "Bytes"); overscan (number, default 8); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: selected (data-selected), active (data-active), non-printable (data-dot), hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, editor.bg, editor.fg, editor.gutter, editor.selection, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, syntax.string, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, text.code-sm.leading, text.code-sm.size, text.code-sm.tracking, text.code-sm.weight
- Accessibility: The bytes are an ARIA grid (role="grid", aria-readonly, aria-multiselectable) with one tab stop; the active byte is aria-activedescendant and is always rendered, even while scrolled away. Each byte cell is labelled with its offset and value ("1f: 6c"); each row has its offset as rowheader and its ASCII as one cell labelled "text: …". The footer announces the selection (aria-live="polite") and its copy buttons are ordinary buttons. Focus shows the double ring on the grid and a ring on the active byte: ring.width in color.ring.

### HoverCard

[hover-card.json](hover-card.json): A preview of what a link points to, on Base UI's PreviewCard: shown while the pointer rests on the link or the link has keyboard focus, styled as a Popover, size.panel.sm wide.

Usage: Use HoverCard to preview the target of a link without leaving the page: a table name in a message, a foreign key, a connection in the status bar. Compose it as HoverCard > HoverCardTrigger (the link: href and the page's link classes) + HoverCardContent (side, align) with read-only content. The link must work without the card and the card must not hold anything the user needs to click: it disappears when the pointer leaves. For a label on an icon button use Tooltip; for controls the user clicks to open, Popover.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/preview-card
- Parts: HoverCardTrigger (data-slot hover-card-trigger): The link (an <a>); give it href and the page's link classes.; HoverCardContent (data-slot hover-card-content): The portal, the positioner and the card.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); delay (number, default 600); closeDelay (number, default 300); href (string); side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" | "inline-start" | "inline-end", default "bottom"); align ("start" | "center" | "end", default "start"); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.link, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.ring, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, radius.lg, radius.xs, ring.offset, ring.width, size.panel.sm, space.inline.sm, space.inset.md, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The trigger is an ordinary link, named by its text; it works (Enter follows it) whether or not the card opens. The card opens on hover after delay and on keyboard focus of the link; Escape closes it and focus stays on the link; leaving the link and the card closes it after closeDelay. The card is supplementary and read-only: nothing in it is required to complete a task, so screen-reader users lose nothing when it is not announced. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the slide and fade transitions off. The card takes the link's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

### Icon

[icon.json](icon.json): A Fluent UI System Icon (vendored offline, MIT) as an inline svg: regular or filled artwork, sized by size.icon.*, coloured by currentColor or a token text role.

Usage: Use Icon for every pictogram: <Icon icon={ChevronDown} /> with an export of @/lib/icons (ChevronDown, Database, Search, Dismiss). It takes the surrounding text colour (tone="inherit"), or a role through tone (muted, accent, danger, warning, success, info). size follows size.icon.* (xs 12, sm 14, md 16, lg 20, xl 24 px) and picks Fluent's 16, 20 or 24 px drawing. filled is Fluent's solid style, for a selected or active state. An icon beside text is decorative (hidden from screen readers); one that stands alone needs label, or put it in an IconButton with aria-label. Import only the icons you use. To add an icon, vendor it with pnpm --filter @byterygon/ui icons add <name> --from <@fluentui/svg-icons tarball> (offline), never draw one by hand.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- size: xs, sm, md, lg, xl
- tone: inherit, default, muted, subtle, accent, danger, warning, success, info
- Props: icon (IconDefinition); size ("xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", default "md"); tone ("inherit" | "default" | "muted" | "subtle" | "accent" | "danger" | "warning" | "success" | "info", default "inherit"); filled (boolean, default false); label (string); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<SVGSVGElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.status.danger.fg, color.status.info.fg, color.status.success.fg, color.status.warning.fg, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xl, size.icon.xs
- Accessibility: Renders an inline svg with focusable="false"; it is never in the tab order. Decorative by default (aria-hidden): the text next to it says what it means. A standalone icon takes label (role="img" with aria-label), or sits in an IconButton whose aria-label says what the button does. Colour is never the only cue: a status icon (Info, Warning, ErrorCircle, CheckmarkCircle) differs in shape too, and status text goes with it. Tones use text roles checked at 4.5:1 on their surfaces.

### IconButton

[icon-button.json](icon-button.json): A square, icon-only action button (Fluent 2's icon-only Button) with Button's appearances in small, medium and large, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.

Usage: Use IconButton where a familiar icon says enough and space is tight: toolbars, table rows, inside an InputGroup. Put an Icon (`<Icon icon={Copy} />`, @/lib/icons) inside and describe the action in aria-label ("Copy connection string", not "Copy icon"); the type requires it. Subtle is the default; use primary for the one main action of a toolbar. When the icon is not obvious, use a Button with text instead. The old variant prop (ghost is subtle) and sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/button
- appearance: primary, secondary, outline, subtle, transparent, danger
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: aria-label (string); appearance ("primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "subtle" | "transparent" | "danger", default "subtle"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); variant ("primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger", deprecated: use appearance (ghost is subtle)); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); loading (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); type ("button" | "submit" | "reset", default "button"); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled), loading (data-loading)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.disabled, color.bg.layer, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.default, color.border.disabled, color.border.strong, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.danger.solid-fg, color.status.danger.solid-hover, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.xl, space.inline.sm
- Accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it. aria-label is required by the type and names the action; Icon is aria-hidden without its own label, so the name is not read twice. Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy. The small size (size.control.sm, 22 px in compact) passes WCAG 2.2 target size (minimum 24 px) only with spacing around it; keep IconButtons at least gap-inline-xs apart, or use medium in dense toolbars. The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only: an outline in color.ring (kept in forced-colours mode) around color.ring-inner, at least 3:1 on every surface and layer; every appearance's colours are contrast-checked by the token build.

### Input

[input.json](input.json): A single-line text input in Fluent's small, medium and large, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.

Usage: Put Input inside a Field with a FieldLabel (and FieldDescription and FieldError as needed); it takes the label, description and validity from it. Use Textarea for multi-line text and InputGroup for an icon, a unit or a button attached to the input. Match the size to the controls beside it. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (aria-invalid), invalid-in-field (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)

- Accessibility: Renders a native <input>; give it a visible <label> (or a Base UI Field.Label), or aria-label when there is no room for one. Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface. Mark errors with aria-invalid and point aria-describedby at the message; the danger hairline and bottom edge is not the only signal. The bottom edge (color.border.control-bottom) meets 3:1 on every fill and surface a field takes, as WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's boundary; the hairline (color.border.subtle) is decoration. Focus shows Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline).

### InputGroup

[input-group.json](input-group.json): A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.

Usage: Use InputGroup when something belongs to the input: a search icon, a fixed prefix (postgres://), a unit (ms), or an action on the value (Copy, Test, Show). Put InputGroupAddon and InputGroupButton before or after InputGroupInput in the order they should appear, and wrap the group in a Field for its label and error. For an unrelated action next to an input, use a plain Input and a Button side by side. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- Parts: InputGroupInput (data-slot input-group-input): The text control (Base UI's Input): takes a Field's label and validity; its value, onValueChange and onBlur as Input's.; InputGroupAddon (data-slot input-group-addon): An icon or text in color.fg.muted; clicking it focuses the control.; InputGroupButton (data-slot input-group-button): A Button (ghost by default) one size smaller than the group, inset from the frame; Button's props.
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input]:focus-visible]), invalid (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][aria-invalid=true]]), invalid-in-field (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.xl, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: The control is a native <input>; give it a FieldLabel through a Field, or aria-label. Addon text is not part of its name: say in the label or description what a prefix means. Icon is aria-hidden in an addon unless it has a label; an icon-only InputGroupButton needs aria-label. Tab moves from the control to the button; the frame's focus underline follows the control, the button has its own double focus ring. Clicking an addon focuses the control, so the whole frame is a click target. The frame's bottom edge (color.border.control-bottom) meets 3:1 on every fill and surface; invalid turns the hairline color.status.danger.border and the bottom edge color.status.danger.solid (3:1), with FieldError's message, not colour alone.

### JsonViewer

[json-viewer.json](json-viewer.json): A JSON value as a keyboard-navigable, virtualized tree or as text, in the editor's syntax colours, with a toolbar (Copy, Expand all, Collapse all, Expand to depth, Find, Tree | Text) and a context menu on every row.

Usage: Use JsonViewer to read any JSON value: a payload, an inspect result, a schema, a response, DBee's value viewer for json and jsonb cells. One component gives every place the same tools: Copy (the whole value, formatted or minified), Expand all (capped at maxExpandRows, with a message), Collapse all, Expand to depth, Find (Mod+F, in keys and values of the tree or in the text, with a count, next and previous and case), and a Tree | Text switch. Pass value (parsed) or text (parsed here; invalid JSON shows an alert with the parser's message). defaultExpandDepth sets how much is open at first. defaultMode="text" starts in Text (a request body, an event as stored); mode and onModeChange let the app remember the choice. A row has a context menu and keys: Copy value (Mod+C), Copy path in jq style such as .items[0].id (Mod+Shift+C) and Copy key (Mod+Alt+C). The tool's own buttons go in the toolbar through `actions`; do not import app code into the component. Give it a height (h-panel-sm, h-full in a sized panel): it renders only the rows in view, so large arrays stay fast. onActiveChange gives the JSON Pointer of the row the keyboard is on. Use CodeBlock for code that is not data (a command, a snippet), CodeEditor to edit JSON. Pass a stable value (memoize it): a new value object resets what is open.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: value (unknown); text (string); defaultExpandDepth (number, default 1); aria-label (string, default "\"JSON\""); onActiveChange ((path: string, value: unknown) => void); maxStringLength (number, default 1000); overscan (number, default 10); invalidText (ReactNode, default "\"Not valid JSON:\""); mode ("tree" | "text"); defaultMode ("tree" | "text", default "\"tree\""); onModeChange ((mode: "tree" | "text") => void); toolbar (boolean, default true); actions (ReactNode); maxExpandRows (number, default 200000); onCopy ((kind: "value" | "path" | "key" | "formatted" | "minified", text: string) => void); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: active (data-active), expanded (data-expanded), match (data-match), current-match (data-current-match), hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (data-invalid)
- Tokens: border.width.1, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.layer, color.border.default, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.fg, editor.bg, editor.fg, editor.gutter, editor.line-highlight, editor.match, editor.selection, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, syntax.constant, syntax.identifier, syntax.number, syntax.operator, syntax.string, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, text.code-sm.leading, text.code-sm.size, text.code-sm.tracking, text.code-sm.weight
- Accessibility: The ARIA treeview pattern: one tab stop (role="tree") with aria-activedescendant naming the active row (always rendered, even outside the window); rows are role="treeitem" with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset and aria-expanded on containers. Keys: Up and Down move, Right opens a container then enters it, Left closes it then goes to its parent, Home and End go to the ends, Enter and Space toggle; Mod+C, Mod+Shift+C and Mod+Alt+C copy the active row's value, jq path and key; Mod+F opens Find, Enter and Shift+Enter (or F3) step through the matches, Escape closes it. The toolbar is role="toolbar" with one tab stop and arrow keys between its buttons; the Tree | Text switch is a group of two pressed-state buttons. Find announces its count (3 of 17) in a polite live region; a copy announces what it copied in a status region. Keys, indices and values are text; colour (syntax.*) only repeats the kind, and strings keep their quotes. A matching row is marked by a background, and the count says where the match is. Invalid text renders role="alert" with the parser's message. Virtualized: only rows in view are in the DOM, so screen readers move row by row with the keys rather than reading the whole value. Text mode is a focusable, scrollable region of selectable text.

### Kbd

[kbd.json](kbd.json): A keyboard key or shortcut shown as text: a <kbd> in the code type role on an inset background, with KbdGroup for combinations.

Usage: Use Kbd in help text, menus and tooltips to show a key (Esc) or, with KbdGroup, a shortcut (Ctrl + K). Write the separator between the keys as text (+, then). Kbd shows a shortcut; it does not bind one. For a symbol (⌘, ⇧) add hidden text that names the key.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Parts: KbdGroup (data-slot kbd-group): Lines up the keys of one shortcut with their text separators, in text.caption and color.fg.muted.
- Props: children (ReactNode); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.border.subtle, color.fg.muted, font.sans, radius.sm, size.icon.xs, space.inline.xs, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: Renders <kbd>, which marks keyboard input; KbdGroup is an outer <kbd>, as HTML nests the keys of a combination. Screen readers read the key labels and the text separators; write "Ctrl", not an icon alone. A <kbd> takes no aria-label: give a symbol (⌘) visually hidden text (sr-only) and mark the symbol aria-hidden. Not focusable and not interactive; nothing to operate. color.fg.muted on color.bg.inset is contrast-checked as text by the token build.

### KeyValueEditor

Duplicate keys (when not allowed), a value without a key and a value that is not base64 are marked invalid with a message; the app decides whether to block sending. ### LogViewer

[log-viewer.json](log-viewer.json): Log lines as they arrive (container and pod logs, a Compose project's merged logs): appended through a ref with no React state per line, at most maxLines kept, virtualized rows, ANSI SGR colours and bold, italic and underline on the terminal.* roles, stdout and stderr marked, timestamps, follow, wrap, and search with Mod+F.

Usage: Use LogViewer for output that keeps coming: a container's or pod's logs, a build, a Compose project's services merged by time (streamColumn with a chart category per service). Lines never go through props: call ref.append(lines) as they arrive (each { ts?, stream?, text }, text with ANSI escapes as the process wrote them) and ref.clear() for a new run. Keep follow in the app's toolbar with onFollowChange: scrolling up stops following, scrolling back to the end or the footer's Follow resumes it. Give onDownload to offer the loaded lines as a file (the app saves it). Mod+F, F3 and Shift+F3 search the loaded lines; ref.openSearch() opens the bar from a button. Use Terminal for an interactive session, CodeBlock for a fixed snippet, JsonViewer for structured data.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: ref (Ref<LogViewerHandle>); maxLines (number, default 50000); follow (boolean); defaultFollow (boolean, default true); onFollowChange ((follow: boolean) => void); wrap (boolean, default false); timestamps (boolean, default true); formatTimestamp ((ts: string | number) => string); streamColors (Record<string, LogStreamColor>, default "{ stderr: \"danger\" }"); streamColumn (boolean, default false); onDownload ((text: string) => void); emptyText (ReactNode, default "No log lines yet."); aria-label (string, default "Log"); overscan (number, default 12); className (string)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible)
- Tokens: color.bg.layer, color.border.subtle, color.fg.muted, color.ring, color.ring-inner, font.mono, font.sans, radius.lg, ring.inner-width, ring.width, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, terminal.bg, terminal.fg, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, text.code-sm.leading, text.code-sm.size, text.code-sm.tracking, text.code-sm.weight
- Accessibility: The lines are role="log" with aria-live="off" (a busy log would flood a screen reader) and an accessible name; the scroller is the tab stop, so arrows, Page Up and Page Down scroll it and End follows again. Mod+F opens a search bar (role="search") whose count is announced politely; Enter and F3 go to the next match, Shift with them to the previous one, Escape closes it and returns focus to the log. Colour is never the only mark: stderr rows also carry data-stream, the stream column names the stream, and every ANSI colour reads at 4.5:1 on terminal.bg (the token build checks each pair). Focus shows the double ring: ring.width in color.ring around ring.inner-width in color.ring-inner.

### Menubar

[menubar.json](menubar.json): A row of menus, as at the top of a desktop window, on Base UI's Menubar: titles that open DropdownMenu-style menus (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus), moving between menus with the arrow keys or the pointer once one is open.

Usage: Use Menubar for an application's menu row in a web build, where the window has no native menu: File, Query, View, Help. Compose it as Menubar > MenubarMenu (one per menu) > MenubarTrigger (the title) + MenubarContent > MenubarItem (MenubarShortcut at the end; danger for a destructive one), MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarRadioGroup with MenubarRadioItem, MenubarGroup with MenubarLabel, MenubarSeparator, MenubarSub > MenubarSubTrigger + MenubarSubContent. - Props: orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); loopFocus (boolean, default true); modal (boolean, default true); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.layer, color.bg.overlay, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.lg, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The row is role="menubar"; each title is role="menuitem" with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; each popup is role="menu" of menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items. One title is in the tab order; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between titles (wrapping), Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens a menu with its first item highlighted; while a menu is open ArrowLeft and ArrowRight open the neighbouring menu; Escape closes and returns focus to the title. Inside a menu: arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses; ArrowRight on a sub-trigger opens its submenu. Disabled items stay reachable but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. ### MultiSelect

[multi-select.json](multi-select.json): Several choices from a list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox with multiple: each chosen item is a removable chip before the input, with Combobox's popup and items, in three sizes.

Usage: Use MultiSelect when the user picks any number of values from a list (columns, privileges, schemas, tags). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items and a function child that renders each one as a ComboboxItem, as for Combobox; value is an array. Items that are { value, label } objects show their label on the chip; for ids from a Combobox.createItems collection pass itemToStringLabel. For one value use Combobox or Select; for a few always-visible options, a CheckboxGroup. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

Typing filters; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight, Enter adds or removes the highlighted item and the list stays open. Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip; ArrowLeft at the start of the input moves onto the chips, where Backspace or Delete removes one. Each chip is named by its text and its remove button by removeLabel ("Remove SELECT"); the clear button is named by clearLabel. The chevron is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology. ### NumberInput

[number-input.json](number-input.json): A number input on Base UI's NumberField with decrement and increment buttons, bounds, steps, locale formatting, and Fluent's small, medium and large.

Usage: Use NumberInput for a number the user types or nudges: a port, a pool size, a timeout. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; with TanStack Form wire value (a number, or null when empty), onValueChange and onBlur to the field. Set min, max and step, and format (Intl.NumberFormat options) for units or percentages; the value stays a plain number. Arrow keys step, Shift+arrow or PageUp/PageDown take largeStep. For a value in a range where the exact number matters less, use Slider; for identifiers that only look like numbers (an account number, a ZIP code), use Input. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/number-field
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: value (number | null); defaultValue (number); onValueChange ((value: number | null, details) => void); onValueCommitted ((value: number | null, details) => void); min (number); max (number); step (number, default 1); largeStep (number, default 10); format (Intl.NumberFormatOptions); locale (Intl.LocalesArgument); allowOutOfRange (boolean, default false); appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); placeholder (string); decrementLabel (string, default "Decrease"); incrementLabel (string, default "Increase"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); inputRef (Ref<HTMLInputElement>); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=number-input-input]:focus-visible]), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled), at-limit (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inset.md, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: The text control is an <input> with inputmode="decimal" (Base UI); inside a Field it takes the label, description and aria-invalid. Without a Field, give it an aria-label. Arrow Up and Down change the value by step, Shift+arrow and PageUp/PageDown by largeStep, Home and End jump to min and max. The step buttons are named Decrease and Increase and stay out of the tab order (the keyboard already steps); they disable at the limits. A formatted value ("30 seconds") is read as shown; the form submits the plain number. Focus shows Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline) (3:1 on every surface).

### Pagination

[pagination.json](pagination.json): Moving between pages of a long list: a <nav> with Previous, page numbers (first, last, current and its neighbours, gaps as an ellipsis) and Next, from Button and IconButton, in two sizes.

Usage: Use Pagination when a list is served in pages and the user needs to jump between them: the audit log, a list of saved queries. Pass page (from 1), pageCount and onPageChange; siblingCount sets how many pages show around the current one; name the landmark with labels.nav when there are several on a page. Results that stream (the data grid) scroll instead; for a few steps of a task use Stepper. The old sm and md sizes still work for one release.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: page (number); pageCount (number); onPageChange ((page: number) => void); siblingCount (number, default 1); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); labels ({ nav?, previous?, next?, page?: (n) => string }); disabled (boolean, default false); className (string)
- States: current (data-current), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.interactive.selected-hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.xl, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.subtitle-2.leading, text.subtitle-2.size, text.subtitle-2.tracking, text.subtitle-2.weight
- Accessibility: A <nav> landmark ("Pagination", or labels.nav) holding a list of buttons; the current page has aria-current="page" and its selected background, so the state does not rest on colour. Every page button is named "Page n"; the arrows are IconButtons named Previous page and Next page and are disabled at the ends. Tab moves through the buttons; Enter or Space picks a page. Gaps are aria-hidden. Only colours transition; nothing moves.

### PasswordInput

[password-input.json](password-input.json): A password input with a show/hide button, on InputGroup and Base UI's Input, in Fluent's small, medium and large.

Usage: Use PasswordInput for any secret the user types: a database password, a key passphrase, a token. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field like Input. Set autoComplete="new-password" when the user chooses a new secret (the default, "current-password", lets password managers fill a saved one). Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Accessibility: The text control is a native <input type="password"> (type="text" while shown), so password managers, paste and autofill work. Showing the text keeps focus where it was; the value and the caret do not change. Inside a Field the input takes the label, description and aria-invalid.
